cause: A runtime restart is confirmed; the old worker and all native/model services were absent after restart. Exact initial interruption trigger (platform suspension/recycle, OOM, or other termination) cannot be established from retained logs.
recovery: Restart same model configuration and original frozen worker; re-audit existing index and resume qids from rankings.jsonl; do not rebuild complete index.

followup_evidence.limitations: Current-boot OOM counters cannot exclude OOM in previous runtime. Runtime restart is confirmed, but exact initial interruption trigger and platform lifecycle reason are unavailable.
